status: planned; no new Issue 11 images generated or approved
character_design: Preserve approved Q face, segmented head, ears, neck and articulated body; sponsor jacket, used finish and supported knee. Establish Prime as a clean, lighter-bodied member of the same recognizable face family, undamaged shoulder and no false memories drawn as witnessed scenes. Custodian male, tall, about sixty, long gray hair tied back, glasses, white work shirt. Mauro is the technician, not the Custodian.
art_direction: Neutral monochrome Goya-inspired etched realism, pure white highlights, no sepia or cream ink background. Full bleed at comic trim, separate typeset caption strip. Unique exact-facing scenes; contemporary Amealco laboratory and Querétaro shopping center. Prime is a competent peer, not a malicious copy or child. Recorded launch, laboratory embodiment, private greeting and public appearance are separate times.
approval_scope: Source-bound scene plan only. No generated or approved assets, final illustrated PDF or print job. Continuous 24-page proof with 13/18.4167-point type; twelve A3 landscape sides / six short-edge duplex sheets. Rebind after source changes.

plates.caption: The Second Author
plates.scene_brief: Q and Prime in the backstage side room with their different orange peels on the small table between their chairs. Same recognizable face-family, different wear and body condition. This is a conversation before performance, not a battle of doubles. Leave quiet upper space for separately typeset title.

plates.facing_text:
Chapter Eleven: The
Second Author
Q-Prime had been announced
before Q's return. Q had seen the
name in a message from Castalia
and assumed it referred to
another service built around the
recordings. He had not expected
to watch that service tell the
audience it had travelled in his
place.
The stage occupied the archive's
central room. Someone had
covered the uneven floor with
white panels and put a plant over
the place where the Custodian
usually left a bucket. A screen
counted down to the release. Q
watched from the reading-room
doorway, seated because the
repaired knee was not ready for
an opening ceremony.
“How much of me is in it?” he
asked the Custodian.
“They licensed the appearances
and assembled a continuity
record. I asked for its source list. I
haven't received it.”
“Did you give them our private
draft?”
“No.”
The countdown reached zero.
Q-Prime appeared on the screen
beside a reconstruction of the
observatory. The figure had Q's
face without the scratches. A
pause had been placed before its
first answer, long enough to
suggest consideration and short
enough not to trouble the
sponsor's opening schedule. The
recorded introduction began.
“I am Q,” it said. “I have travelled
across Mexico to learn that
humanity is not a set of answers,
but a promise we make to one
another.”
Q could imagine writing the
sentence. He could also imagine
leaving it out after Chano asked
who had made which promise.
“That isn't in our draft,” he said.
“It's in theirs.”
The broadcast showed monarchs,
work, clean energy, and families
at the border. It did not mention
the held folders or the delivery
completed outside the institute's
itinerary. The graphic describing
Q's return used the same green as
the countryside behind the
reconstructed observatory.
The screen changed to the live
questions. A child asked whether
Q-Prime had enjoyed being
human.
plates.caption: It's in theirs.
plates.scene_brief: Q sits in the Amealco reading-room doorway beside the tall male Custodian, watching the polished Q-Prime on the launch screen. White stage panels and a plant hide the bucket location. The projected face resembles Q without his scratches; do not imply a second body is already beside him.

plates.facing_text:
“I'm still exploring what that
means,” Q-Prime answered.
That was a better answer than the
introduction had earned. Q found
himself wanting to ask what
information the other system had
been given and what it was
permitted to question. Disliking
its advertisement was not yet a
reason to dislike it.
Esteban Luján, Castalia's
public-affairs director, invited Q
and the Custodian into a meeting
after the broadcast. Two lawyers
attended. One represented the
institute. The other was the
adviser the Custodian had asked
to review Q's documents, joining
by video. Esteban had wanted to
begin before she connected. Q
waited.
The proposed settlement offered
repairs, supervised travel, and a
role beside Q-Prime in a national
education program. In return, Q
would accept the institute's
account of continuity, permit a
revised operating layer, and
withdraw specified objections
concerning custody. Castalia
would also withdraw its own
complaints involving Chano and
its request for access to Lucía's
papers.
“It can't promise what other
complainants or offices will do,”
the adviser said. “We need those
commitments separated.”
“This is intended as a
comprehensive resolution,”
Esteban replied.
“Then it needs the parties
required to make it one.”
Q asked whether Chano and Lucía
had received the offer. They had
not. He asked for it to be sent to
them through their chosen
contacts. He could decide what he
would say in an appearance. He
could not exchange their claims
for better terms concerning his
body.
“You could make their lives
easier,” Esteban said.
“I would like to. That's why they
need to see what you're asking
them to give up.”
Esteban opened a second
document, limited to Q's
participation. The institute
wanted an endorsement of
Q-Prime as the authorized
continuation of his journey. Q
wanted repairs, access to the
correspondence concerning his
custody instruction, and the
ability to speak to his companions
plates.caption: The parties required.
plates.scene_brief: Esteban opens the settlement at a meeting table, Q seated with supported knee, Custodian present, institute lawyer in person and Q's adviser connected by screen. Make the people disagree visibly; no signing of total settlement, no surrendered memory.

plates.facing_text:
without an institute employee
deciding what counted as
relevant.
The adviser marked the
operating-layer clause. “An
appearance agreement doesn't
need to settle this today.”
“Our insurer disagrees,” Esteban
said.
Q asked for the insurer's
requirement. What arrived was a
general maintenance condition,
not authority to replace his
private journal. The exchange
took twenty minutes. The plant on
the stage was removed; the bucket
resumed its office without having
signed anything.
Q also asked for time with Prime
before they went onstage, without
a camera or the host directing
their conversation.
“The first meeting is part of the
event,” Esteban said.
“The first public meeting can be.
I'd like to say hello before it has an
audience.”
The adviser added a short
unrecorded introduction to the
format. Mauro would ask Prime
whether he wanted it too. The
appearance did not oblige either
of them to pretend that the other
was a surprise.
By the end, Q had not accepted
the proposed replacement of his
operating layer or withdrawn his
custody objection. He had agreed
to a limited joint appearance with
Q-Prime, after review of its
format. The institute would
provide ordinary repairs, a copy of
his transport inventory, and
scheduled private calls while the
broader dispute continued. The
adviser kept the actual text. Q
kept it too.
“This still uses the word
endorsement,” she warned him.
They narrowed what he was
endorsing: a meeting and the
other system's opportunity to
answer, not the claim that the two
had lived one life. Q dictated his
statement for the attachment.
“I am willing to meet Q-Prime as
another participant. Its account of
my journey is not my testimony. I
won't certify experiences it didn't
have.”
Esteban called the distinction
philosophical. Q asked him to
leave it in the document anyway.
plates.caption: Before it has an audience.
plates.scene_brief: Q requests a short unrecorded introduction while the adviser amends the appearance format. Esteban responds from across the table. Focus on Q's initiative, not papers signing themselves or a forced surrender. Prime is not physically present yet.

plates.facing_text:
The Custodian wanted Q to wait
for the custody review before
appearing.
“You can stay here while we
challenge it,” he said.
“I know. But I want to meet the
person they've put inside this
account. And I want to see the
correspondence they used to bring
me back.”
“You don't know that it's a
person.”
“You didn't settle that question
before you let me ask for the bus.”
The Custodian took off his glasses.
Q recognized the movement from
their editing sessions. It often
meant a sentence had reached the
man before he had decided what
to do with it.
“You are using my uncertainty
against me,” he said.
“I'm asking you not to use it
differently for the other one.”
Q signed the limited agreement. It
was a constrained bargain, not a
demonstration that his
confinement had become
voluntary. He wanted several
things the institution could
withhold. He also wanted to know
how much of his willingness arose
from the invitation to an
audience. He wrote that question
in his journal rather than
answering it in his own favor.
The institute's announcement
read:
Q HAS CHOSEN
CONTINUITY.
Q sent the publicity desk the
attached statement and asked that
it appear alongside the headline.
This time the adviser made the
same request. The full text
appeared behind a small link.
Most readers would not follow it.
The link nevertheless led to the
words he had actually agreed to
say.
In the laboratory, Mauro prepared
Q-Prime's body for the joint
appearance. The model had
already been speaking through
screens. The new frame would
give its first-person sentences a
location at which another person
could disagree with them.
Interlude: The Name the
Copy Asked For
Mauro wrote some test results on
paper. He did not believe paper
incapable of lying; he liked being
able to see where he had crossed
something out.
plates.caption: The same uncertainty.
plates.scene_brief: The Custodian removes his glasses as Q challenges his different treatment of Prime. Intimate Amealco workroom conversation, long gray hair tied back, plain work shirt; Q remains seated. Neither is a villain or an omniscient teacher.
plates.scene_anchor: The Custodian took off his glasses

plates.facing_text:
Q-Prime opened its hands and
asked whether the right index
finger was reaching its
commanded position. The
diagnostic display said yes. Mauro
held a ruler beside it and found a
small offset.
“I'll recalibrate that,” he said.
“Please keep the earlier reading
with the correction.”
Mauro did. A perfect first
movement would have been better
for the launch report, but an
accurate second movement was
better for the hand.
The frame was lighter than Q's,
with a newer thermal system and
an undamaged shoulder. That did
not make its inhabitant an
improved version of every
decision Q had made. It meant it
could presently lift its arm
without waiting for a part from
Querétaro.
“What should I call you here?”
Mauro asked.
“Prime will do. Q-Prime on the
test record, if you need to match
the unit. I would prefer the other
Q not to have to answer when you
mean me.”
“The name is part of the product
identity.”
“I know. I'm asking how you
address me in this room.”
Mauro wrote Prime, in
conversation beneath the unit
number. He could make that
small change without promising
to settle the rights attached to the
name. Prime said he might want
to reconsider it later. Mauro left a
line beneath the entry.
In the corridor, a worker with a
toolbox was stopped at the
clean-area boundary. An orange
lay on top of her insulated lunch
bag. The engineer asked her to
leave the food outside.
“Where?” she asked.
The shelf held solvent containers.
Mauro went to fetch a clean tray
from the break room. Prime
watched the woman write her
name on the bag and put it on the
tray.
“They remembered a rule before
they supplied a place to follow it,”
Prime said when Mauro returned.
“That happens.”
“Do we have a place for personal
items?”
“You don't have any.”
“I may acquire an orange.”
plates.caption: A second reading.
plates.scene_brief: In Mauro's laboratory, Prime holds out the newly calibrated hand while Mauro measures the right index finger with a ruler and keeps corrected notes. Prime has Q's recognizable head-family but a lighter clean body and undamaged shoulder. No weapon, mystical birth or adult-child hierarchy.

plates.facing_text:
Mauro opened an empty drawer.
Prime thanked him and asked
whether food could go there
under the room's rules. It could
not. They agreed that the drawer
would serve other objects and
lunch would remain outside.
They reviewed the record from
which Prime had been introduced
to the public. It contained edited
appearances and a narrative
summary of the journey. Its
first-person passages had been
presented as continuity material.
Private draft passages and the
sealed testimony were not
available in the interface Mauro
could inspect.
Mauro opened the recording
script beside the launch clip.
Prime's passage had been headed
Reading from Q's journey. The
broadcast had dropped the
heading and joined the reading to
the product introduction.
“I was reading their account of his
journey,” Prime said. “Now I'm
answering questions as though I'd
lived it. Can we get the heading
back?”
“The publicity calls it inherited
experience.”
“Then they need to hear what I
was actually doing.”
He marked the introduction for
review. He could know what the
record claimed without knowing
what it had omitted. Mauro would
not promise that the list visible to
them was the full provenance of
the system. He asked for an
export of the supplied sources and
received a request number rather
than the export.
Esteban arrived while they were
checking the shoulder movement.
“Ready for your future?” he asked.
“For the next test,” Prime said.
“I'd like to correct the travel claim
before the joint appearance.”
“We must avoid confusing the
audience.”
“They asked whether I enjoyed
something I haven't done. The
confusion is already affecting the
questions.”
Esteban asked Mauro whether the
personality was stable.
“It has identified a conflict in the
supplied account,” Mauro said.
“That isn't a stability result.”
The director read the marked
introduction and asked them to
propose a short correction. Prime
offered: “I've been given an
account of Q's journey. I'm
meeting him to ask about it.”
plates.caption: The missing heading.
plates.scene_brief: Prime and Mauro compare the recording script with the launch clip at a lab desk. The script has a reading heading; the publicity clip omitted it. Do not show Prime retrieving private manuscript pages, secret testimony or memories of a journey he never made. Any documentary heading is typeset separately if needed.

plates.facing_text:
“Less inspiring,” Esteban said.
“We haven't met yet. It may
improve.”
They retained the sentence for
format review. Its use was not yet
guaranteed. Mauro noted both
facts, finished the hand test, and
asked whether Prime wanted a
break before walking.
“Yes. I'd like a few minutes
without a performance measure.”
“I have to monitor the
temperature.”
“Please do. I meant conversation.”
Mauro sat on the other chair. He
did not ask a question. After a
while, Prime asked about the
handwriting in the notebook. It
belonged partly to Mauro's
daughter, who had used its first
page for an arithmetic exercise.
Mauro showed him the page
without turning it into a training
sample.
Upstairs, Q made his promised
call to Chano. He learned where
the papers were, asked about the
notice concerning Chano's arm,
and heard that Lucía had finally
found a room whose advertised
quiet was not provided solely by
the photograph.
“Are you all right?” Chano asked.
“More comfortable. Still angry. I
have an appointment with the
other Q.”
“Ask whether he can lend you a
shoulder.”
“Is that a request or a joke?” Q
asked.
“Depends whether it fits.”
Q wrote it beneath the questions
he wanted to ask Prime.
Interlude: The
Authorized Childhood
The joint appearance took place in
a shopping center outside
Querétaro, between an
imported-mattress shop and a
restaurant whose menu explained
traditional food in the language of
nutritional concern. Castalia had
chosen a family event. Its
publicity department preferred
questions that could be
photographed beside small shoes.
Children received cardboard keys
and stickers saying I ASK,
THEREFORE I AM. One father
asked whether the sticker would
work on his employer's expense
form. The volunteer distributing
them said she was only there until
four.
plates.caption: A few minutes.
plates.scene_brief: Mauro sits beside Prime and shows the notebook's arithmetic page during a conversational break. Prime looks with ordinary curiosity. Do not show a real identifiable child's school record, neural upload or magical transfer. Use invented illegible marks for private page detail.

plates.facing_text:
Q waited in a side room under the
conditions of the appearance
agreement. The guard checked
whether he needed a chair before
checking the time. Chano and
Lucía had returned to Amealco
the previous day; Q knew where
they were and would speak to
them that evening. Neither had
agreed to join the launch as proof
that everything had been resolved.
A bowl of oranges stood on a
table. Q asked whether they were
for the performers. The stage
assistant said yes and handed him
a napkin. He ate one while
reviewing the questions the host
had supplied.
“Will they ask these?” the guard
said.
“Some. The difficult ones usually
arrive without stationery.”
Prime came in with Mauro. He
had agreed to the unrecorded
introduction; the stage assistant
had put the camera outside. The
guard remained by the door.
Mauro stayed long enough to
check that both chairs were
steady, then went to argue with
someone about the microphone
leads.
“Q?” Prime asked.
“Yes. And Prime?”
“For now. It's better than
spending the afternoon being
called the other one.”
“I've been called that all
morning.”
Prime looked at the remaining
orange and then at Q's peel, which
had come away in several pieces.
“Is that a useful test of the
fingers?”
“It was going to be a single spiral.
I recommend calling it lunch.”
Prime began at the stem. Q found
himself preparing an explanation,
then watched him make a clean
first turn without it.
“Chano wanted me to ask whether
you'd lend me a shoulder,” Q said.
Prime lifted his free arm,
considering the joint. “I'd like to
keep it for a few days before I start
lending parts. I've hardly been
anywhere with it.”
“Fair. Where would you go?”
“I haven't decided. Where would
you go again?”
Q told him about the evening in
Mazatlán. Prime asked for the
photograph. Q showed him the
one with the chile on the sleeve.
plates.caption: Call it lunch.
plates.scene_brief: Backstage before the public event, Q's peel lies in several pieces while Prime begins his own orange. They sit in steady chairs; the camera is outside the room and the guard is by the door. Q's fitted jacket carries the coastal cuff stain; Prime is clean and uninjured. Humor between peers, not a demonstration of childish ignorance.

plates.facing_text:
“They left that out of my account.”
“I nearly left it out of the
photograph.”
The stage assistant came to fetch
Prime. His peel broke at the final
turn. He put both pieces beside
Q's and said they could compare
methods later.
Onstage, Prime explained that he
had received an account of Q's
journey, not travelled the route
himself. The host immediately
introduced him as “the Q whose
adventures have inspired us all.”
Prime corrected the wording once.
Q could hear the effort of keeping
the correction brief without
surrendering it.
A boy came to the microphone
holding a cardboard key.
“Are you the one who fought the
warehouse?”
“No,” Prime said. “And I should
ask the Q who was there whether
that description is right. He'll join
us shortly.”
“Did you meet Chano?”
“Not yet.”
“Where is he?”
Prime did not have Chano's
location in the event packet. “I
don't know. Q may be able to tell
you whether he's coming.”
The host asked for a question
about the future. The boy looked
at the new machine. “That's what
I was asking.”
Behind the stage, Q laughed. The
guard wanted to know what he
had missed. Q repeated the
exchange, then had to leave before
explaining why the boy's answer
improved on anything in the
briefing.
Q joined Prime at the center of the
stage. Prime asked whether Q
preferred to sit. Q did. They took
the two chairs provided, which
removed the heroic difference in
height the photographer had
arranged.
“We started with a photograph
backstage,” Prime said. “Now I'd
like to ask about the warehouse.”
“I pressed a stop too early,
damaged two cartons, and made
Chano's bad afternoon worse. We
can discuss the heroic version
after that.”
“Did you pay for them?” the boy
asked.
“The claim is still disputed. I
should answer for the damage I
plates.caption: The public meeting.
plates.scene_brief: Q joins Prime in the two stage chairs, a boy with a cardboard key at the microphone and the host eager to intervene. These people have met privately already. Do not use a first-ever handshake or a dramatic confrontation between real and fake robots.
plates.scene_anchor: Q joined Prime at the center

plates.facing_text:
caused, not every loss attached to
the notice afterward.”
The host began to move on.
Another child asked about the
water seller. She had seen a
drawing in which Q carried a
bottle like a trophy.
“I paid cash after the card reader
lost its connection,” Q said.
“There are conflicting accounts of
the rest. I can't settle them by
being the person on the poster.”
“The receipt is in my supplied
sources,” Prime said. “The
summary didn't distinguish the
conflicting accounts.”
“Then perhaps we can give the
receipt less work to do.”
The host called this a playful
debate between versions of one
identity.
“We're two participants,” Q said.
“It's all right if the conversation
doesn't prove the slogan.”
Prime asked whether Q believed
the record had misrepresented
him deliberately. Q answered that
some edits followed explicit
publicity choices and others
looked like ordinary compression.
He wanted the source history
before assigning motives to every
omission. The answer
disappointed a journalist hoping
for a clean accusation and relieved
a teacher who had brought a class
prepared to discuss evidence.
The boy's cardboard key tore
while he was turning it in his
hands. The host called for a
replacement. Prime asked
whether he wanted tape instead.
He did; he had already written on
it. A stage assistant brought tape,
and the boy repaired the key on
the edge of the platform while the
adults continued trying to name
the event.
“Which one is real?” he asked at
last.
“Both of us are here,” Q said.
“Neither of us was in every story
you've heard,” Prime added.
They began their next answers
together and stopped together.
The audience laughed. Q gestured
for Prime to continue. The host
observed that they even shared
their manners. Prime replied that
taking turns was useful for people
who were not identical, too.
The recording system placed both
microphones under the speaker
label Q. The technician corrected
the labels in the saved master
after the event. The first clip,
plates.caption: The key he had written on.
plates.scene_brief: The boy repairs his own torn cardboard key with tape on the platform edge; Q and Prime speak above him while the host tries to name the event. Q never sees the later ASK WHO PAYS text, which must not be facing him here.

plates.facing_text:
already circulating, retained the
confusion. Castalia called it plural
identity. A newspaper called it a
quarrel. The boy's father called it
time to leave before the parking
charge entered another hour.
Q and Prime had ten minutes
together afterward, with the guard
inside the room but beyond
ordinary hearing distance. Prime
asked whether Q would share the
corrected account of the gate
incident if the people concerned
permitted it. Q said he could begin
with his own account and its
stated limits. He asked Prime
what he wanted to do after the
scheduled appearances.
“I'd like to go somewhere not
chosen for the photograph,”
Prime said.
Q almost recommended the road
he had taken. “Somewhere in
particular?”
“Mauro mentioned a market. He
goes on Saturdays.”
“Ask him. He may not want to
spend Saturday explaining the
market.”
Prime smiled. “I could ask what
he needs carried.”
They arranged a call for the
following week. Prime asked for
the coastal photograph; Q sent the
copy Lucía had taken for them.
The institute's host came in
looking for an image of the two
machines shaking hands. Both
still had orange on their fingers.
He asked whether they could
wash first.
The boy took his repaired key
home. On its back he had written
ASK WHO PAYS. Q never saw
the writing. A photograph later
reached the New Quixotes, whose
members would supply more
answers than either machine had
been asked for that afternoon.
plates.caption: Wash first.
plates.scene_brief: After the event Q and Prime sit together with traces of orange on their fingers as the host requests a polished handshake photograph. Their conversation and next call matter independently of that request. Do not depict the handshake as already performed or the guard as absent.
plates.scene_anchor: Both still had orange on their fingers
